title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.110
exact_target: For each exceptional finite simple group of Lie type, bound by five the conjugates needed to generate with an automorphism, and determine the exact worst-case number.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2619 (KOU-21.110). CC BY 4.0.

R. Guralnick, J. Saxl and D. O. Revin, Problem 21.110, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026).
